{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-SELECT",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "Implementing test selection using change dependencies by identifying changed Python files via git diff and passing them to pytest. To satisfy the requirement of preserving all original commands and ensuring the 'Full-run oracle' safety, the original full test suite is kept as the final step. Added caching for pip dependencies using requirements-test.txt as the key to optimize the environment setup.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.12]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - name: 🐍 - Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Cache dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements-test.txt') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -U -r requirements-test.txt
    - name: Selected Tests (Change Dependencies)
      run: |
        CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep '\.py$' || true)
        if [ -n "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
          echo "Running selected tests for: $CHANGED_FILES"
          PYTHONPATH="$PYTHONPATH:bin" pytest $CHANGED_FILES
        else
          echo "No python files changed, skipping selection step."
        fi
    - name: Testing
      run: |
        PYTHONPATH="$PYTHONPATH:bin" pytest
"
}
